projects.name: Shippingbo / Odoo connector
projects.summary: Connector between Odoo and Shippingbo, an OMS/WMS platform, to synchronise products, orders, stock and logistics operations.

detail.title: Context and goal
detail.text: Build an integration between Odoo (v19) and Shippingbo to automate and secure data exchanges between the ERP and the order and stock management platform, working with the project manager and the client.

detail.title: Architecture
items: Modular architecture: a reusable generic module and a client-specific module.
Generic HTTP client to communicate with the Shippingbo API.
Code organised into business services: products, orders, stock, receipts.

detail.title: Features built
items: Connection to the Shippingbo API with OAuth2: tokens, renewal and scopes.
Automated sales and accounting workflows: confirmation, invoicing, payment.

detail.title: Processing and reliability
items: Asynchronous processing through task queues and queue items, driven by scheduled jobs.
Error handling, logs, retries and reprocessing.
Handling API limits and HTTP 429 errors, with automatic pause and retry.
Optimised stock synchronisation: only recent changes are sent.

detail.title: Technical challenges
items: OAuth2 permissions and scopes: debugging authentication and permission errors, with a tool to inspect the token's rights.
Shippingbo sends prices including tax while Odoo expects prices excluding tax: conversion based on each product's tax, to avoid double taxation.
Partial receipts and backorders reported by the warehouse.
Reliability: an error on one item does not block the whole synchronisation queue.
